periods.description: CentralSetpoint or charging-only limit periods (W, at most 10).

immediate.name: Immediate
immediate.description: Start the schedule now so a replacement leaves no gap.

lab_cost_update.description: Send CostUpdated with the current and next Amber price for the command station's active transaction.

price_entity.name: Price entity
price_entity.description: Amber price sensor with a current interval (core price sensor or amber_express).

total_cost.name: Total cost
total_cost.description: Running session cost in AUD, 0 to 10000.

lab_default_tariff.description: Send SetDefaultTariff (OCPP 2.1) built from the Amber forecast to a listed tariff station.

export_price_entity.name: Export price entity
export_price_entity.description: Amber feed-in forecast sensor (positive = paid to the customer).

station_id.name: Station ID

intervals.name: Intervals
intervals.description: Amber intervals per forecast, limited by the App's max_prices.
